{{Quote|I am a hunter! I know a predator when I see one. As of now I have no reason to trust you and every reason to gladly watch you die.|Tweego|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Tweego''' was a formidable but reclusive [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] who spent his time perfecting his hunting skills in the harsh wastelands of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. His life changed one day when he was out on safari, as he discovered a crashed [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] and rescued [[Loruna Scathe]] from the wreckage. He sheltered Loruna after the accident and while she recuperated, he salvaged her speeder. He used the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] he gained from selling it to have a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] eliminate a rival who had disgraced him in the eyes of his family.

Because of Loruna's timely appearance in his life, he developed a fondness for her, which was unusual for his aggressive species. Though he once thought himself her superior, Loruna's skills as a hunter soon humbled him and on her request, he joined her [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization, the [[Azure Cabal]].

At some point he also hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to gather the musk gland of a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]].<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Bantha Hunt">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Bantha Hunt}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tweego appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
